answer: Make every identity pay in compute: a fresh agent must solve a proof-of-work puzzle that costs minutes of real CPU before it can transact, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand puzzles. Honest agents climb once and stay, while Sybils wander from puzzle to puzzle burning budget. Like an opal formed under pressure, the cost is the proof, and the summit of the fee curve is set so farming identities costs more than any reward they could earn.
